svg.title: BURIED • NINE BELL LOCATIONS
svg.desc: Original Dead Drop written reference diagram. Map each physical bell to its bulb before pulling the lever.
svg.text: Map each physical bell to its bulb before pulling the lever.
Left entrance bench arm • table opposite the judge
Low left section of the judge’s bench
Table by furnace • table opposite stairs
Chair beside the stair-room entrance; no power switch here
Hay by wall opening • hay behind leaning board
Far back corner, furthest from the stairs
Past the moving bookcase; nine bulbs on the chair
Call yellow → ring its mapped bell → confirm green
These are location groups, not a fixed nine-bulb solution.
Original reference diagram • not an in-game screenshot
